findings.message: Loop R3 is labelled reinforcing but its links make it balancing: it runs through 3 negative links, and a loop reinforces on an even count and balances on an odd one. Either the label or one of the arrows is wrong, and this reading does not assume which.
Loop B4 runs through a link with no stated polarity, so whether it reinforces or balances cannot be counted. Mark every link in it with + or - to decide it.
